newsitem.title: USA: Fleet up on rumors, says no corporate news.
newsitem.headline: Fleet up on rumors, says no corporate news.

text.p: Fleet Financial Group Inc shares were higher Friday afternoon on speculation about a merger with NationsBank Corp, Wall Street traders said, but Fleet issued a statement saying it knew of "no corporate developments" to account for the stock activity.
A spokesman for NationsBank declined comment, saying the Charlotte, N.C.-based bank holding company does not respond to rumors.

Fleet said it was reaffirming its policy of not commenting on market rumors but in response to an inquiry from the New York Stock Exchange about activity in the stock, it was making an exception. Fleet said "it knows of no corporate developments that would account for market activity in its shares today."
Fleet was up 1-1/4 to 60-3/4 in late afternoon and had traded as high as 63-1/2. NationsBank was off 1-1/4 to 60.
